result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make it impossible to dehumanize another person.

People could still be selfish, afraid, angry, wrong. But that specific mental move—the one that says *your pain doesn’t count, your life is lesser, you are not really one of us*—would be gone. So much cruelty isn’t just emotion; it’s permission. I’d remove the permission.
